name: thefinalcutbg/DinoDent
what_it_is: Open-source dental practice management desktop application written in C++ with Qt6, built specifically for Bulgarian dentists with deep integration into Bulgarian national health and tax systems. It manages patient dental and periodontal records, financial documents, and electronic submissions to NHIF, NHIS, NRA, and PIS.
components: PKCS11 hardware token interface for document signing
protocols: XML with C14N canonicalization (NHIS message signing)
measurement: Dental status and procedure history per tooth
Financial aggregates: invoices, debit/credit notifications, fiscal receipts
configuration: PDF output directory and naming structure
modes: Rqlite mode: distributed SQL with optional mTLS
constraints: Bulgaria-specific: national health/tax integrations are hard-coded; not usable outside Bulgaria (an international fork QDento exists separately)
Requires physical PKCS11 hardware token for signing official documents
Qt6.8+ required; LimeReport must be built from source
Desktop-only; no web, mobile, or API interface
No automated test suite or CI configuration
notable_absences: No audit log beyond practice-level separation
